experimental_method: Flow saturator (gas saturated at T+20 C in two cylinders) then condensed at the dew-point temperature in three cylinders; water measured by Karl Fischer coulometric titration with gas-clock volume; mean of five samples.
uncertainties_stated: Pressure transducer 0.05 bar; pressure variation +-0.1 bar during experiment; bath stability +-0.01 C; mirror dew point within +-0.5 C of bath; samples accepted when max/min within 5%; gas clock <0.2%.
quality_remarks: Authors compare with literature (Table 8 spread; Althaus 283.15 K/100 bar 175.6 vs this work 182.3 ppm). Gases: N2 99.999%, CH4 99.964%. Temperature scale not stated.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean; every cell matched the rendered page image; no corrections
